# Versions published alongside the site root.
#
# The root of the published site is always the current `main`, and no URL under
# it ever moves. This file lists the *additional* copies published under
# /<major.minor>/, each built from its own tag with that tag's own toolchain —
# its own poetry.lock, its own mkdocs.yml, its own build-site action. An old
# version therefore renders the way it did when it was written, not the way
# today's Material would render it.
#
# The list is checked in rather than derived from `git tag` for two reasons.
# A tag is not automatically a published version — see the release bar in
# README.md — and the "cited" half below cannot be derived from tags at all:
# nothing in this repository knows which version another repository points at.
#
# Retention is the union of two rules, not the first one that matches:
#
#   recency  one of the last five minor versions. Retired by age: when a sixth
#            minor is tagged, the oldest `recency` line is removed.
#   cited    a downstream repository links at this version explicitly. Never
#            retired on age. Remove the citation over there first, then this
#            line — the same order the anchor contract uses.
#
# A `recency` version that stops building is dropped from that deploy and the
# run goes red; a `cited` version that stops building fails the deploy outright,
# because publishing without it breaks a link someone else depends on.
#
# Format: <major.minor>  <tag>  <recency|cited>
#         blank lines and `#` comments are ignored.

0.1  0.1.0  recency
